extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from primary XML/PDF text and supplement figure text; no direct membrane or molecular mechanism assay was performed in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports antimicrobial and antibiofilm activity for USCL/gUSCL lipopeptides, but these are phenotypic activity endpoints rather than direct mechanism-of-action assays.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: lipopeptides 1-18, with antibiofilm testing focused on 7-9 and 16-18
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote MIC/MBEC phenotypes to direct membrane, biofilm, or molecular mechanisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The authors interpret activity, hemolysis, and cytotoxicity as related to hydrophobicity, fatty acid chain length, and serine/glycosylated-serine position.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Correlation plots and selectivity indices support structure-activity interpretation, not a direct cellular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Membrane permeabilization is discussed as prior-context behavior of ultrashort cationic lipopeptides, not as a direct assay result generated in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Retain as background mechanism context only.
